The '''2020–21 Ligue 1''' season, also known as '''Ligue 1 [[Uber Eats]]''' for sponsorship reasons, was a French association football tournament within [[Ligue 1]]. It was the 83rd season since its establishment. The season started on 21 August 2020 and ended on 23 May 2021.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.ouest-france.fr/sport/football/ligue-1/ligue-1-ligue-2-decouvrez-les-calendriers-generaux-de-la-saison-2020-2021-6884399|title=Ligue 1 - Ligue 2. Découvrez les calendriers généraux de la saison 2020-2021|work=Ouest France|access-date=19 March 2023|date=26 June 2020|language=fr}}</ref> The league fixtures were announced on 9 July 2020.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.lfp.fr/Articles/COMMUNIQUÉS/2020/07/03/les-calendriers-de-ligue-1-uber-eats-et-ligue-2-bkt-devoiles-le-jeudi-9-juillet|title=Les calendriers des rencontres dévoilés jeudi 9 juillet|website=LFP|language=fr}}</ref>

[[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]] were the three-time defending champions, after they were awarded the title for the [[2019–20 Ligue 1|previous season]] following the league's cancellation due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in France|COVID-19 pandemic]].

Following a 2–1 win against [[Angers SCO|Angers]] on the final day of the season, [[Lille OSC|Lille]] secured a fourth French league title, and their first since [[2010–11 Ligue 1|2011]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.ligue1.com/Articles/MATCH-REPORTS/2021/05/23/lille-ligue-1-champions-after-angers-win|title=Lille Ligue 1 champions after Angers win|publisher=Ligue 1|date=23 May 2021|access-date=23 May 2021}}</ref>

==Teams==
===Changes===
[[FC Lorient|Lorient]] and [[RC Lens|Lens]] were promoted from the [[2019–20 Ligue 2]]. After the French court had initially ruled that the season would proceed with 22 teams,<ref>{{cite web|title=Ligue 1 relegation overruled for Amiens and Toulouse but Lyon appeal dismissed|url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11800/12003511/ligue-1-relegation-overruled-for-amiens-and-toulouse-but-lyon-appeal-dismissed|access-date=16 June 2020|website=Sky Sports}}</ref> the relegation of [[Amiens SC|Amiens]] and [[Toulouse FC|Toulouse]] to the [[2020–21 Ligue 2]] was confirmed on 23 June 2020, following a vote by the LFP.<ref>{{cite web |title=LFP : l'assemblée générale vote à 74,49 % le maintien d'une Ligue 1 à vingt clubs |url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Lfp-l-assemblee-generale-vote-a-74-49-le-maintien-d-une-ligue-1-a-vingt-clubs/1145914 |website=[[L'Équipe]] |access-date=23 June 2020}}</ref>

==Relegation play-offs==
The 2020–21 season ended with a relegation play-off between the 18th-placed Ligue 1 team, [[FC Nantes|Nantes]], and the winner of the semi-final of the Ligue 2 play-off, Toulouse, on a two-legged confrontation.
